description:
Rescoped 2026-05-13 per Mark's Option-A decision after the do-beads triage.

## Background

This bead originally specified a comprehensive integration test matrix for all 12 Space/set semantic mutation sub-ops, plus permission checks for all 4 permission tags (manage_space, manage_roles, manage_members, manage_channels), plus ULID assignment validation, plus role-hierarchy and cascade tests.

When JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 / .4 / .5 landed, the implementing agent's triage (see prior comment) found that much of the matrix is already covered by tests landed in those impl beads, but the residual items have scope mismatches with the current implementation:

- **manage_space gate doesn't exist** — top-level Space metadata goes through `update_object`, not `apply_space_patch`. Adding tests for it requires landing the gate first. Split to JMAP-g7wu.2.4.13.
- **manage_channels gate is missing on Channel/Category ops** — `validate_role_member_ops` explicitly skips them. Split to JMAP-g7wu.2.4.14.
- **ULID assignment doesn't match impl** — `MemoryBackend::next_id` returns sequential strings (`"role1"`, `"chat3"`). Split to JMAP-g7wu.2.4.15 (design decision).

## What remains in scope here

A single multi-variant smoke test ("kitchen sink") that exercises all 12 semantic mutation keys in one `/set` call against a single Space, with an admin caller. The goal is to verify the 12 variants don't interfere with each other on the existing code paths and that the dispatch / parsing / atomicity handling holds up under a mixed-op load.

## Acceptance

- New test in `crate-jmap-chat-server/tests/role_member_apply.rs` (or a new `tests/all_ops_kitchen_sink.rs` if cleaner) exercises a single `Space/set` call carrying all 12 semantic-mutation keys: addRoles, removeRoles, updateRoles, addMembers, removeMembers, updateMembers, addChannels, removeChannels, updateChannels, addCategories, removeCategories, updateCategories.
- Caller is an admin holding all permissions; this test verifies dispatch correctness, NOT permission gating (that's covered by the per-op tests in .4.3/.4.13/.4.14).
- Assertion: response is success with the expected mutations reflected on the Space. No SetError. The 12 ops apply in a single atomic transaction per RFC 8620 /set atomicity-at-the-target-level.
- Estimated ~80 LOC.

## Out of scope

- manage_space permission gate (JMAP-g7wu.2.4.13)
- manage_channels permission gate (JMAP-g7wu.2.4.14)
- ULID format assertion (JMAP-g7wu.2.4.15 — design decision pending)
- Re-deriving per-variant permission tests (already covered by .4.3 et al.)
- Per-variant cascade tests (already covered by .4.3 / .4.4 / .4.5 et al.)

## Cross-references

- JMAP-g7wu.2.4.13 — manage_space gate (autonomous)
- JMAP-g7wu.2.4.14 — manage_channels gate (autonomous)
- JMAP-g7wu.2.4.15 — ULID design decision (human)
- JMAP-g7wu.2.4.3 — Role/Member apply_space_patch + tests (canonical pattern this kitchen-sink extends)
title: Kitchen-sink integration test: 12 Space/set semantic-mutation ops in one call
